# Awesome Grok Bot

> Curated live official share links you can Add to Grok Bot, plus field cases and community tools.

100 live shares in catalog.json: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/majiayu000/awesome-grok-bot/main/catalog.json
Human index: https://github.com/majiayu000/awesome-grok-bot
Chinese: https://github.com/majiayu000/awesome-grok-bot/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md
Featured notes: templates/
Vetting: docs/vetting.md
Team recipes (one share = one bot): packs/
Official role starters (not importable): docs/official-starters.md
Field cases sit above the 100 shares (real runs, grouped by roster / computer-use / gotchas): README.md#field-cases
Linux desktop: the Bot computer is already Linux; official desktop apps are macOS, Windows, and iOS; unofficial thin-client ports are indexed at falser101/grok-bot-linux: README.md#linux-desktop
Skills and tools (local/study, factory, CLIs, bridges, playbooks, indexes, OSS alts): README.md#skills-and-tools
Community tutorials: README.md#tutorials
Reviews: README.md#reviews
